name: Joy UI

name: shadcn/ui
summary: shadcn/ui is an open-source collection of accessible React components styled with Tailwind CSS, distributed as source code copied into projects by the 'shadcn' CLI and registry rather than as a component package. It is built by shadcn at Vercel and uses Radix or Base UI primitives underneath.

license.name: MIT License
license.notes: Copyright (c) 2023 shadcn. MIT: retain copyright and permission notice. Component source is copied into consumer projects by design, and MIT permits this.

notes: Classified component-library although it calls itself 'not a component library': it is a curated, documented catalog of styled components distributed as code. The 'shadcn' npm package is the CLI. Installation guides cover React frameworks only (Next.js, Vite, TanStack Start, React Router, Astro, Laravel with React), so only React is listed. Vue/Svelte ports (shadcn-vue, shadcn-svelte) are community projects. The docs changelog includes 'January 2026 - Base UI Documentation' alongside Radix. figmaUrl is null because the official Figma page says its kits are community-contributed.
